$schema_note: Data-driven spec for the AIDC Studio generic equipment models (neutralization stream N1b, 2026-09-15). Models are keyed by STANDARD FORM FACTOR and configuration, never by vendor: no logos, lettering, card art, HMI screens or vendor trade dress. Tags on every number: standard (cited public standard fact) | catalog (taken from the AIDC catalog dims so the viewer fit is exact) | estimate (our own assumption). The OCP-standards design round reuses form_factors + layouts; generic_usd.py reads nothing else.

sources.EIA: EIA-310 19-inch rack facts (panel 482.6 mm, 1 U = 44.45 mm, rail opening 450 mm, hole c/c 465 mm) as summarised in https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/19-inch_rack
sources.ORV3: OCP Open Rack V3: 21-inch (537 mm) IT width, OpenU = 48 mm, 600 mm outside width - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Open_Compute_Project (citing opencompute.org Open Rack/SpecsAndDesigns); 48 V busbar + rear liquid manifolds - https://techarena.ai/content/why-does-ai-need-a-wider-rack
sources.MGX: NVL72-class rack: 1 RU liquid-cooled compute and switch trays, 19-inch EIA gear in an ORV3-width frame, 18 compute + 9 switch trays, blind-mate manifold - https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/nvidia-contributes-nvidia-gb200-nvl72-designs-to-open-compute-project/ (used only for the tray count / pitch; no visual reference)
sources.ORW: Open Rack Wide (ORW) Base Specification V1.0.0 (2026-04-28) - https://www.opencompute.org/documents/open-rack-wide-orw-base-specification-v1-0-0-final-pdf ; Open Rack Wide (ORW) Meta Design Specification V1.0.0 (2026-04-28, drawings rev 1.0 of 2026-03-13) - https://www.opencompute.org/documents/open-rack-wide-orw-meta-design-specification-v1-0-0-final-pdf . Values used as data only (no spec text or figures copied): nominal 2390 x 1200 x 1219 mm, OpenU 48.00 mm, 44 OU / 47 RU / 88 half-OU, inner verticals 1094.44 mm, floor-to-canopy 2389.9 and base-surface-to-canopy 2239.89 mm, datum A to +48 V busbar 802.59 mm, no casters (forklift / pallet / AGV base), HAC seal plane 1068 mm from the front face, 4700 kg braced payload, 125 kg per IT support shelf set. Values checked in the P0 closure (docs/research/ocp/p0-rack-power.md section 2.1, private notes).
sources.CATALOG: packages/core/src/catalog/catalog.ts + seeds/facility.ts dims (w, d, h in metres)

palette.$note: sRGB hex. Neutral greys only: nothing yellow / cyan / aqua (reads as trays / network lines) and no saturated red / blue pipes (reserved for information layers). Look names avoid /screen|led|emis/ so the viewer's GLB emissive override (apps/web/src/viewer/models.ts) leaves them alone.

orw-wide-44ou.pitch_tag: standard (ORW Base 1.0.0: OpenU 48.00 mm; 44 OU / 47 RU / 88 half-OU)
orw-wide-44ou.panel_tag: standard (inner verticals 1094.44 mm, ORW Meta Design 1.0.0 drawings); faceplates are drawn to fill the opening
orw-wide-44ou.columns_tag: estimate (generic wide-tray facade: two half-width faceplate fields with a divider; not a tray design)

frame_mm.tag: standard (ORW Meta Design 1.0.0: nominal 2390 x 1200 x 1219 mm; drawing values 2389.9 / 1200.24 / 1219.24 mm)

orw-wide-44ou.tag_plinth_top: plinth derived (floor-to-canopy 2389.9 minus base-surface-to-canopy 2239.89 = 150 mm, ORW Meta Design 1.0.0 drawings); top canopy thickness estimate

busbar.tag: standard (datum A to +48 V busbar 802.59 mm, ORW 1.0.0 drawings; frame busbar interfaces identical to the high-power 21-inch rack busbar interface, ORW Base 1.0.0 section 4.3); datum placed at the front vertical (faceplate) plane - estimate; busbar width and depth estimate (overall busbar depth is not defined by the base specification)

base.tag: standard (no casters; forklift / pallet / AGV base, ORW Meta Design 1.0.0); pocket size and pitch estimate

orw-wide-44ou.hac_tag: standard (default hot-aisle containment seal plane 42 in = 1068 mm from the front face, ORW Meta Design 1.0.0)
orw-wide-44ou.payload_tag: standard (ORW Meta Design 1.0.0: payload 4700 kg minimum with allowable bracing, excluding the frame; 125 kg per IT support shelf set, dynamic)
orw-wide-44ou.notes: Released V1.0.0 documents (no draft chip). The liquid-cooled busbar specification is in progress and no busbar current / kW rating is stated, so the model carries no rating.

$layouts_note: Layouts are bottom-up band lists [start (1-based), count, kind] with an optional 4th element = units per tray (default 1; count must be a multiple); kinds: compute | switch | power | mgmt | blank | stiffener. Every unit of the form factor must be covered exactly once (generic_usd.py checks it). Band positions are a generic DLC rack-scale configuration (power top and bottom, scale-up switches in the middle) and match the U-map resolver in packages/core/src/layout/rackContents.ts so 2D elevations and 3D agree.
